methodology: Independent H3 res-4 global land screen. No 39/107 catalogue coordinate is used to generate, sample, score or cluster cells. Catalogue distances are computed after clustering for novelty classification and preservation only. WorldClim 2.1 10-minute climate/elevation, Natural Earth 1:110m land, OurAirports access. Transparent profile rules; missing evidence masked.

grid.areaMethod: cellCount * average H3 res-4 area; approximate, not a geodesic polygon area

worldclim.temperatureUnits: degrees C (native raster values, verified by direct sampling)

land.exclusions: Water cells are excluded. Polar, island and remote land cells are retained.

airports.distance: straight-line spherical distance to nearest airport

dimensionDefinitions.thermal: mean annual temperature at or below profile target; WorldClim bio1 in degrees C
dimensionDefinitions.aridity: annual precipitation at or below 150 mm, soft to 600 mm
dimensionDefinitions.access: log-scaled distance to nearest scheduled large/medium airport

screening.missingData: Dimensions with no value are excluded from the weighted mean and coverage; they are never imputed or treated as negative evidence.
screening.ml: The existing 39-site ML surrogate is not used to generate, rank or label these regions.
